svg.title: Qualifying a proxy before relying on it
svg.desc: Three stages run downward. Relevant observations record the candidate and intended use, the workload, tool, and operating scope, and matched proxy and reference results. Agreement checks assess held-out error and ranking, false acceptance and rejection, and agreement against the declared decision tolerance. Bounded use applies the proxy where the checks support it, retains the assessed scope and limits, and reopens qualification when conditions change. A dashed route from each stage leads to a fourth box, requalify before relying on the proxy: when evidence is missing, agreement is inadequate, or scope has changed, collect matched reference results, revise the proxy, or defer use, and assess agreement again under the intended conditions.

g.text: Candidate and intended use; workload, tool, and operating scope
Held-out error and ranking; false acceptance and rejection
Agreement assessed against the declared decision tolerance
Use supported by the checks; retain assessed scope and limits
Requalify before relying on the proxy
Missing evidence, inadequate agreement, or changed scope:
Collect matched reference results, revise the proxy, or defer use.
Assess agreement again under the intended conditions.
